comment: Single source of truth for the agent tool surface. The sidecar compiles these in and serves them over MCP, scripts/generate-agent-tools.mjs emits the Rust method lists, and pnpm agent-tools:check proves every method still has a handler. Edit here, then run pnpm agent-tools:generate.

guide.name: guide
guide.description: Read this before your first task launch or browser click: cursors, idempotency, UI opens, and the tab model.
guide.comment: Served by the sidecar from its own bundle, so it has no harness method.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Open a URL in this tab, or a new one with newTab, and wait for the load.

tools.name: browser_state
tools.description: Read the tab: url, title, numbered elements, text and tabs. Numbers expire on the next read.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click a numbered element or an x,y point; double double-clicks, hover only moves there.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type into a numbered element, replacing its value, or at the caret. submit presses Enter.

tools.name: browser_press
tools.description: Press a key or chord, such as Enter, ArrowDown or Meta+a.

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.description: Drag from one element or point to another.

tools.name: browser_upload
tools.description: Give files to a file input, as if picked in its chooser.

tools.name: browser_dialog
tools.description: Answer the page's open alert, confirm or prompt.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page, or a numbered element, by deltaY pixels; negative is up.

tools.name: browser_extract
tools.description: Read the page's visible text, or the parts matching a CSS selector.

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Run JavaScript in the page; the result comes back as JSON.

tools.name: browser_network
tools.description: List the page's fetch and XHR calls with status, timing and body.

tools.name: browser_console
tools.description: List the page's console messages and uncaught errors.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the tab; fullPage for the whole page, annotate to number elements.

tools.name: browser_annotate
tools.description: Draw a labelled box or a caption over the page.

tools.name: browser_record
tools.description: Start or stop recording this tab to an MP4 video.

tools.name: browser_wait
tools.description: Wait ms milliseconds, then for any load to finish.

tools.name: browser_back
tools.description: Go back in this tab's history.

tools.name: browser_forward
tools.description: Go forward in this tab's history.

tools.name: browser_list_tabs
tools.description: List this agent's browser tabs with their ids.

tools.name: browser_switch_tab
tools.description: Make one of this agent's tabs the current one. Returns page state.

tools.name: browser_close_tab
tools.description: Close one of this agent's tabs.

tools.name: workspace_inspect
tools.description: Inspect this agent's open project, panes, configured tasks, runs, and event cursor.

tools.name: task_start
tools.description: Start a configured project task in a managed terminal.

tools.name: task_read
tools.description: Read task status and new terminal output by byte cursor.

tools.name: task_stop
tools.description: Stop the exact managed task execution and its process tree.

tools.name: ui_open
tools.description: Open a project file, diff, task terminal, or the configured preview.

tools.name: events_wait
tools.description: Wait for project task or UI events after an event cursor.
